{{samename|grandfather of [[Kieran]] and [[Carmine]]|Yukito and Hideko}} ---- {{CharInfobox| color=FEEA00 | corecolor=F4EE5A | bordercolor=F6D703 | name=Grandpa| jname=じーちゃん | tmname=Grandpa | slogan=no | image=Grandpa MPJ.png| size=150px | caption=Grandpa | age=no | gender=Male | hometown=Unnamed | region=[[Kanto]] | relatives=[[Coconut]] (granddaughter), [[Ginger]] (wife) | trainer=no | game=no | leader=no | team=no | brain=no | anime=no | manga=yes | roundnum=PPP01 | roundname=How Do You Do, Pikachu? | }} '''Grandpa''' (Japanese: '''じーちゃん''' ''Grandpa'') is a creepy mad scientist in [[Magical Pokémon Journey]]. He is a genius at making all sorts of things, such as love potions, magic mirrors, and a magical suit that will protect its wearer from harm. == History == He sent [[Hazel]] out to catch {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} for him so that he could impress girls, but she has not yet caught any. {{sectionstub}} == Personality and characteristics == Grandpa is married to [[Ginger]] and is the grandfather of [[Coconut]]. He is apparently the president of Pog, Inc, but does not want to return because running the company isn't fun.
